content.edit-hero-name: Moon Rathi — DevOps Engineering Intern & Cloud Specialist
content.edit-hero-bio: DevOps Engineering Intern at Mactores and B.Tech CS student specializing in Cloud Computing. I focus on designing resilient cloud infrastructure on AWS, automating provisioning with modular Terraform, containerizing workloads with Docker, and setting up secure CI/CD pipelines that keep releases predictable.
content.edit-about-text: I spend most of my time working at the intersection of cloud architecture and automation. Currently interning at Mactores as a DevOps engineer, I've spent extensive time designing production-style AWS environments with Terraform, building serverless and containerized micro-pipelines, and exploring AI-assisted engineering workflows with tools like Claude and Amazon Bedrock.
content.edit-about-focus: AWS · Terraform IaC · Docker · CI/CD · GenAI Workflows
content.edit-p1-desc: Event-driven AWS pipeline where S3 uploads trigger Lambda to orchestrate a Dockerized Python container on ECS Fargate for structured extraction. Persists to DynamoDB with SES alerts and scales to zero compute cost when idle.
content.edit-p2-desc: Automated repository analysis and Dockerfile generation pipeline using AWS Bedrock and ECR. Features context collection that auto-detects dependencies and runs GitHub Actions CI/CD with OIDC auth and Trivy vulnerability scans.
content.edit-p3-desc: Production-style multi-AZ architecture on AWS deployed with modular Terraform. Security-first routing through an ALB into private EC2 compute and private RDS subnets, with remote S3 state management and zero direct public database access.

content.edit-preferred-text: AWS · Terraform · Docker · CI/CD Pipelines · Linux
